relationships.subject: LY2828360
relationships.evidence_quote: Both CB2 agonists, LY2828360 and AM1710, dose-dependently reduced mechanical and cold hypersensitivity in CB2f/f mice but lacked anti-allodynic efficacy in AdvillinCRE/+; CB2f/f mice.

relationships.subject: peripheral sensory neuron CB2
relationships.evidence_quote: These observations support our hypothesis that CB2 receptors in peripheral sensory neurons are necessary for the anti-allodynic effects of both LY2828360 and AM1710 in paclitaxel-induced peripheral neuropathy.

relationships.subject: LY2828360
relationships.evidence_quote: In paclitaxel-treated male mice, LY2828360 blocked the development of morphine tolerance

key_findings: Anti-allodynic effects of CB2 agonists LY2828360 and AM1710 require CB2 in peripheral sensory neurons (Advillin-Cre cKO abolishes) but not CX3CR1 microglia/macrophages
LY2828360 sparing of morphine tolerance is sexually dimorphic (male only) and depends on sensory neuron CB2
